opening.argument: The described offer is presented as a points-based promotion tied to ordinary app activity and purchases. Viewers are instructed to download the app and may receive Rs 25 for referring another person, while purchasing a product through the described store is linked to receiving gift coupons. The on-screen instructions further show entry and verification of a mobile number, a referral code, and referrals to friends, while the points screen states that a purchase is needed to redeem points. These materials explain how the reward process is supposed to work; they show redemption instructions rather than a completed outcome, and nothing described establishes that the offer was deceptive.
